initialNgsSale.payout: Official policy states seller payout equals USD Transfer Price after successful delivery; no additional international logistics/customs/VAT deductions from the defined TP.
initialNgsSale.postCustomerReturnAdjustment: UNKNOWN: public NGS article does not state whether an already-issued original TP payout is reversed, partially adjusted, or retained when the delivered order is later returned.

salableReturn.disposition: Noon moves the returned unit into local FBN inventory in the destination market.
salableReturn.pricing: Seller may set the local FBN price; if omitted Noon applies a default price intended to yield an amount close to the original Transfer Price at time of sale.
salableReturn.storage: FBN storage fee waived for up to 60 days.
salableReturn.feesAfterConversion: Applicable marketplace FBN referral fee, outbound fee, and later storage/other applicable fees apply to subsequent local FBN sale/inventory.
salableReturn.sellerControlReturnAdmin: If return is due to seller-controllable reasons such as item different from listing, fake, damaged, defective, used, missing parts or extra items, local FBN rate card lists a return administration fee equal to the lesser of 15 local currency units or 20% of referral fee.

nonSalableReturn.removalOrDisposalFee: NGS policy says no inventory removal or disposal fee is charged for this liquidation route.
nonSalableReturn.alternative: Seller may choose return-to-vendor/local warehouse (RTV); exact NGS RTV charges and timing are not specified in the public NGS article.
nonSalableReturn.otherCosts: Original purchase, packaging, China domestic transport to Shenzhen and other sunk costs remain; no recovery value is established.
